consequence: ECMA-262 lets the host omit the SharedArrayBuffer global: its ABSENCE outside cross-origin isolation (D11 FACT-SHARED-THREADS-UNADMITTED) is host/implementation behaviour, not an HTML/ECMA requirement - only the serialization gate (CL-T4) is standard
excerpt:
The SharedArrayBuffer Constructor

The SharedArrayBuffer constructor:

  • is %SharedArrayBuffer%.
  • is the initial value of the *"SharedArrayBuffer"* property of the global object, if that property is present (see below).
  • creates and initializes a new SharedArrayBuffer when called as a constructor.
